A '''bar''' was located near [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] city of [[Tahv]]. In [[3960 BBY]], an [[Unidentified Keshiri bartender|elderly Keshiri]] [[Bartender/Legends|tended]] the bar, serving his patrons [[sweetwater]] and [[Porridge/Legends|porridge]] as well as advice.
